'''Compensators''' were components used in the construction of [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] bikes<ref name="J6">{{JournalCite|6|Swoop Gangs}}</ref> and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].<ref name="BH">{{WEGCite|story=The Bacta Heist|book=Tapani Sector Instant Adventures}}</ref> [[Roy Harlison]] used additional compensators on his [[Nebulon-Q Swoop Racer]] with [[siderider]] attachment.<ref name="J6" />
